caption:
🏙️ Paris, every building standing today by year of construction — 1860 → 2025.

The red core is Haussmann's Paris and the decades after him: by 1914 most of the city you walk through today was already built. Then the 1930s ring of brick housing at the edges, a few towers in the 1970s, and relatively little since: Paris rarely demolishes.

📊 Data: French national building database BDNB (CSTB, Licence Ouverte), which groups adjoining buildings; heights from BD TOPO (IGN). Only 40% of the buildings have an exact recorded year: 48% were recorded as a round decade and are spread over the nearby years, 11% have no year and take the year of neighbouring buildings. Buildings older than 1860 appear from the first frame. Heights exaggerated.
🌍 Map: OpenStreetMap contributors.
